snippet.title: Hawthorn - Story Trailer - Kickstarter
snippet.description:
Hawthorn's Kickstarter is now live! Please help former developers from Bethesda Games and BioWare bootstrap this passion project and join the journey to bring this charming fairytale co-op sandbox RPG sim to life! 

Pledge your support and join our village at:
https://www.PlayHawthorn.com/Crowdfunding/

O----------ooo----------ooo----------ooo----------ooo----------ooo----------ooo----------O
‘Twas three of their fleeting generations ago when, far beyond this valley, the Raven spires of Rookstadt and the gaslit city of Lundwick plotted a trade route to lofty High Eyrie, that ancient citadel of the Owls. The harrowing mountain pass required a trading post and, thus, the old village of Windermere was born.

Oh, how I watched them in those days. The Animal Folk building snug cottages against our ancient trees. Mice, Otters, and Owls dancing in the golden light of their harvest fires. Where at first I resented them, I instead discovered myself longing to join them.

Then, one Winter morning, I woke to find Windermere suddenly empty. No flickering of candle, no more laughter. Every villager had vanished without a trace, and never to this day have I solved this greatest of mysteries.

Now, after long lonesome years, I suddenly hear the voices of Animal Folk among the roots of the Oakshee. I see their bonfire like a Will-o'-wisp in the night, enticing me to follow. Should I approach, a moth to the flame? Or will this new village too fall prey to forces beyond their ken?
O----------ooo----------ooo----------ooo----------ooo----------ooo----------ooo----------O
